prepare:
cat > entrypoint.sh <<'EPOTE'
#!/bin/sh
if [ -f /conf/app.conf ]; then
  CONF=/conf/app.conf; ARGS=-config=/conf/app.conf
else
  CONF=/app/conf/app.conf; ARGS=
fi
if [ -f "$CONF" ]; then
  [ -n "$driverName" ] && sed -i "s|^driverName *=.*|driverName = $driverName|" "$CONF"
  [ -n "$dataSourceName" ] && sed -i "s|^dataSourceName *=.*|dataSourceName = $dataSourceName|" "$CONF"
  [ -n "$dbName" ] && sed -i "s|^dbName *=.*|dbName = $dbName|" "$CONF"
fi
cd /app && exec /app/casdoor $ARGS
EPOTE

GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct "E:/05AIProjects/30zcode/08crosscompile/02loongson2k3000/1panel_port/toolchain/go/bin/go.exe" get modernc.org/sqlite@v1.34.5 && GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct "E:/05AIProjects/30zcode/08crosscompile/02loongson2k3000/1panel_port/toolchain/go/bin/go.exe" mod tidy
dockerfile:
# loong64 self-built (wave7) - store-compatible entrypoint (env -> conf/app.conf)
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/alpine:3.24
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata 2>/dev/null || (sed -i 's|dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org|mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn|g' /etc/apk/repositories && apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata)
WORKDIR /app
COPY casdoor /app/casdoor
COPY conf /app/conf
COPY web/build /app/web/build
COPY entrypoint.sh /app/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /app/casdoor /app/entrypoint.sh
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 8000
ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/sh", "/app/entrypoint.sh"]
